html:
SMTO-LLM-0053 — The AI model sent its list of actions in the wrong form

GUID: 4e941431-f4c5-4b7c-ba7a-e332c03a2e53
Slug: model-calls-shape-invalid
Domain: LLM · Subsystem: llm

What happened

  • The part of the model's reply that lists its actions wasn't a proper list, so SMTO couldn't separate the actions. Nothing from that reply was run.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Look at the steps already shown for this task in the conversation and note which ones finished before the error. Work finished before this reply still stands, so you only need SMTO to continue, not redo it.
  2. Open Settings › Setup › Model routing and pick a different model for Main (and Helper, if one is set), then save. The malformed list comes from the model server, so a different model or server usually sends it correctly.
  3. If someone else runs your AI model server, or a proxy in front of it, tell them the list of tool calls in its replies (tool_calls) isn't sent as a list. That exact detail points them to the part of the server output that needs fixing.
  4. Send a new message asking SMTO to continue from where it stopped, without repeating the steps that already finished. Once the actions arrive as a list, SMTO can run them one by one.

What success looks like

  • SMTO carries out the model's next actions and the task continues without this error.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages your AI model server. You don't need to shorten or clear the conversation; this problem isn't caused by its length.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The model response's tool_calls field is present but is not an array, so the response was rejected before any call was dispatched.

What this means

  • The tool_calls member has a non-array shape where the protocol requires a list of call records or an allowed absent value. This category concerns model preparation or response acceptance. It does not reverse earlier operations or establish their outcome; their receipts remain authoritative.

Why this can happen

  • The tool_calls member has a non-array shape where the protocol requires a list of call records or an allowed absent value.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare the provider's tool_calls encoding with the native list format; do not treat an arbitrary object as a single call automatically.

How to fix it

  • Inspect the raw choices[0].message.tool_calls from the configured endpoint; it must be absent, null or an array of call records. Correct the provider's response encoding or proxy, or route to a compatible endpoint in Settings › Setup › Model routing.
  • Correct the provider response encoding so tool_calls is an array of supported call records.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • tool_calls is absent where permitted or is a valid bounded list of supported call records.

What not to do

  • Do not replay prior successful operations to repair a later model response.
  • Do not disable protocol validation or treat this representation failure as input-context overflow.

Technical notes

  • This category concerns model preparation or response acceptance. It does not reverse earlier operations or establish their outcome; their receipts remain authoritative.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
